name: number_partitioning_k3_n18_seed39761__v14_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 18} into 3 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 57. (The total sum is 18*(18+1)/2 = 171, so the target is 171/3 = 57.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 18 integers in {0, ..., 2} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
